geometry.geometry_revision: user supplied input.json; original 28 vertices, 48 triangular panels, 2 quadrilateral roofs, 76 edges

frames.fea_frame: Right-handed; bottom roof center at (0,0,0), upper roof center at (0,0,0.0264); +Z points toward upper roof
frames.isaac_frame: Right-handed Z-up; floor top Z=-0.005 m. Before contact analytic whole-leg translation; after contact an additional exact display upper-cap transform and linearized relative roof deformation.

source_to_fea.equation: p_fea = scale * R * p_source + translation; no reflection

transform_fea_to_isaac.preview_root_translation_m: [0,0,0.0339 - 0.5*9.81*t^2] for the current neutral leg; recomputed from world-space foot/floor bounds at preview entry
transform_fea_to_isaac.impact_mapping: After first contact keep root drop translation fixed. Rotate about original top cap (0,0,0.145), then add upper-cap translation. Relative FEM deformations measured in initial aligned cap axes; linearized dynamics, no reflection or physical gain.

frames.zero_definition: Original folded JSON neutral shape, zero cable tensions; release from rest
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand small rotation-vector components of the lower cap relative to the moving upper cap; q=D*x. Both assemblies can translate and rotate. Roof rotations in the physical render are exact transforms; FEM constraint modes remain linear.
frames.compression_sign: Positive bottom cap Z translation shortens cap separation.

material.model: Provisional isotropic linear elasticity; perfect PLA/PET bond; no measured stock-grade identification
material.gap_selection: Owner requested least practical exposure. 0.1/0.2/0.4 mm numerical candidates only; manufacturing minimum and optimum NOT established.
material.application_to_drop: These provisional elastic constants determine six-DOF relative cap stiffness and stress recovery from TET10 static constraint modes.

mesh.element_type: Quadratic TET10, four-point Gauss integration, physical PET and PLA thickness
mesh.characteristic_length_note: Highly nonuniform layered mesh; physical film thickness 80e-6 m, exposed gap 200e-6 m. No single representative element length.
mesh.convergence_summary: FAIL: refinement 3->4 compression +15.6811%; PET reference volume +0.765862% across 1->4. Entire reference laminate geometry is not held fixed.

boundary_conditions: Original knee only, initially unloaded/upright; whole leg foot-first released from rest 70 mm above the floor.
Both roof assemblies free after contact. Two assumed spatial mass matrices include all knee/plate mass; no duplicate continuum mass.
Four lower-assembly sole corners use unilateral compliant frictionless normal contact, not rigid zero-penetration contact.
Relative cap stiffness is statically condensed from the existing TET10 FEM with the upper cap fixed only for constraint-mode construction.
Quasistatic cable controller suspended; all 12 cable tensions zero. Return restores same scene/model and unloaded cable workshop.
Terminate at 1% maximum absolute principal strain, 2 degrees relative/assembly rotation, or requested duration. No unsupported continuation.

loads.mass_provenance: Owner authorized example values; provisional 30/20 g partition including joint and roofs. Uniform-box COM/inertia approximation explicit in config, not measured or optimized.

solver.software: Custom reduced FEM-derived impact integrator running in Isaac Sim Kit; not PhysX solid FEM or Ansys
solver.analysis_type: Small-motion two-body dynamics with static TET10 constraint-mode stress recovery
equations: u_FEM = basis*J*q; strain = strain_basis*J*q; stress = elastic_D*strain
solver.stopping_rule: Stop at 1% maximum absolute principal strain or 2 degrees norm of relative, upper or lower rotation vector; guards are not fracture thresholds
solver.timestep_check: 10, 5, 2.5 microseconds; successive guard-time/force/bend differences under 0.2%. Does not establish mesh/physical validity.

limitations: Unconverged legacy PET mesh and reference-normal refinement defect
Omitted interior elastic modes and stress-wave propagation
Linearized rotations and strain; stop at 1% strain or 2 degrees
Assumed mass/inertia, contact compliance and damping; not calibrated
No friction, cable preload, plasticity, self-contact, delamination or fracture
Guard reached while both assemblies still move downward; no complete impact, rebound or strength conclusion
The numerical invariants/timestep tests validate implementation consistency only; modal/full-FEM/experimental correlation absent

review.notes: 22 numeric tests plus actual GUI replay/pause/gain/input/save/restore/refresh checks passed. Rendered roofs remain rigid. Mesh and physical validation gates remain failed; not ML ready.

reproduction.controls: Drop impact + FEM bending (exploratory) > Run / replay impact. Whole leg for contact view; Impact close-up for 1x/500x comparison.
